summary.overview: The Internal Coordination Meeting between Jack and Ahmed focused on resolving critical access and login issues affecting Jack's ability to utilize the CRM system, as he was added as an admin on the marketing engines platform to facilitate smoother operations. They clarified their roles in client management, with Jack stepping into a client-facing role for deal engines and discussing the onboarding process for buy-side clients, including recent challenges he faced in accessing submission forms for client calls. The meeting covered key deal updates, including interest in the Leslie France deal and other potential opportunities, with actionable items assigned to both participants. Jack will follow up on client deals and review necessary forms, while Ahmed will provide Jack with the required documents and continue work on valuations.
summary.short_summary: Jack and Ahmed's internal coordination meeting focused on resolving critical access and login issues impacting Jack's use of the CRM system. Jack was added as an admin on the marketing engines platform to streamline operations, and they clarified their respective roles in client management, with Jack stepping into a client-facing role for deal engines. They discussed the onboarding process for buy-side clients, including challenges Jack faced with accessing submission forms for client calls. The meeting also covered updates on key deals, notably interest in the Leslie France deal and potential opportunities from other parties. Actionable items were assigned, with Jack set to follow up on client deals and review necessary forms, while Ahmed will provide Jack with required documents and continue work on valuations.
